ios.desc:
The Escapees Mail Service mobile app will make your mail service account more accessible and easier to use during your travels. Now you can easily update your mailing instructions, manage mail scans, and access essential account features anytime, anywhere.


With the My Mail Service (MMS) mobile app, you can:
•	Update your account information
•	View your address and digital card
•	Check your account expiration date
•	Update your mailing instructions
•	View and manage mail scans
•	Review mailing and postage history
•	Contact Member Services
•	Submit feedback directly from the app

Simply login with the same username and password you use for your online account/member dashboard. There’s an option to set up your online account if you haven’t done so yet (click “New Members”). 

Download now to manage your mail service membership with ease and on the go.

quotes.text:
In an ideal world, absolutely! But it's impossible to tell unless you personally know someone who can provide evidence. A couple of examples...

PostScan Mail - claims it started in 2012: https://www.postscanmail.com/about.html , which corroborates with their Android app https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.postscanmail.mailbox and Internet Archive https://web.archive.org/web/20250000000000*/https://www.postscanmail.com/

Escapees - claim to be the oldest, having started in '85. But their Android app was released in 2018: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.companyname.escapeesapp&hl=en_US&gl=US, the iOS app owner is different brand and the copyright on that listing says the company started in '95: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/escapees-mail-service/id1612527067. Domain was only bought less than 2 years ago: https://whois.domaintools.com/escapeesmailservice.com

So, should you choose Escapees based on what they claim on their site?

As an aside, I used to analyze insurance companies' creditworthiness, and saw how they played the branding game because people cared about longevity.
quotes.story_title: The Cheapest Virtual Mailboxes in the United States
